Pawpal temperature integration third-party notices
=================================================

All listed upstream libraries are distributed unmodified. Their files remain
separate from Pawpal source. Copyrights and full license texts are retained in
licenses/. The NuGet manifests and packages.lock.json record exact source commits
and distribution hashes. No LibreHardwareMonitor GUI or PawnIO installer ships.

LibreHardwareMonitorLib 0.9.6 -- MPL-2.0
Copyright LibreHardwareMonitor and Contributors; partial copyright Michael
Moeller and Open Hardware Monitor Contributors. All rights reserved.
Source: https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/tree/3d331e3370efb858411f19511373eff65a218701
License: licenses/LibreHardwareMonitor-MPL-2.0.txt

Embedded signed PawnIO modules, upstream module release 0.1.6 -- LGPL-2.1
Source and corresponding module release:
https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/releases/tag/0.1.6
https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/tree/0.1.6
License: licenses/PawnIO-Modules-LGPL-2.1.txt
Upstream source notice: licenses/PawnIO-Modules-README.txt
The upstream modules remain embedded in LibreHardwareMonitorLib.dll. Compatible
modified/relinked LibreHardwareMonitor builds may be used with the application
by rebuilding from the supplied source with the updated assembly manifest.
